    BO13a §2.2.5: the shorter crown #

    MulBasis.b2_core: for long entries σ₁ = σ (s+2) and ρⱼ = ρ (s+3+L+1) (j = L+2), split at a and c', with ρⱼ = γ ≫ ρ₁ ≫ δ and v₁', v₂' arrows, (γ ≫ V₁, r, σₙ, …, ρⱼ₊₁, r'', V₁') is a crown of length 2(n - j + 1) < 2n unless V₁' factors as γ ≫ V₁ ≫ c (BO13a's last case, "the domains coincide").
